verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents a stability score defined as the proportion of user sessions that are error-free, with configurable stability targets. Its dashboard can be filtered by release (including a "does not equal" operator), and release annotations on the timeline correlate versions with error-rate changes. That covers crash-free-session health and a rough release filter, but not the rest of the story. missing for 10: crash-free users metric, adoption-per-release tracking, an explicit canary-vs-stable release comparison view, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
